notes.title: The price of The Price of Freedom
notes.content:
We released The Price of Freedom two and half years ago. Being our first VR title, we wanted to reach as many consumers as possible, and chose to release the title for free. We were overwhelmed by the positive reaction to our work and our story, and thank you for the support.

As a studio our heart is in our games, but we make our living by doing client work and other projects. We want to continue bringing you new VR Experiences, and in order to help move us towards that goal, we are electing to start charging [b]$1.99[/b] for The Price of Freedom. 

This is only for [b]NEW[/b] downloads - if you have already downloaded PoF you will continue to have access.  As the VR market grows this will give us some new cash flow that we can put towards new game experiences - including new episodes of The Price of Freedom.

Thank you again for your support! And keep an eye out - new content is coming soon :)

notes.title: Swallow to Select Chinese
notes.content:
We are releasing our first major update to The Price of Freedom. You can now play through the experience in Chinese by selecting a pill in the beginning. The Chinese version offers full translation of text and audio into Mandarin.

In addition there have been several bug fixes and improvements to the overall experience:

[list]
[*]Mouth colliders have been made more accurate
[*]It is now easier to pick up dropped object from the floor
[*]Fixed misaligned grips on the vase shards
[*]Letters and folders stay open when read
[*]Fixed a bug that caused the gun to not reappear if the player shoots themselves during the assassination
[*]Collisions in the desk are are more accurate
[*]The statue now opens with a simple trigger
[*]The color of the statue button and light has been changed to blue to increase visibility
[*]You can now remove the tape reel from the player
[*]The reel plays by pressing the button, instead of touching  the whole reel
[*]Graphical improvements
[/list]

Enjoy!

notes.title: Hello Agents
notes.content:
Just wanted to drop in and say [b]THANK YOU[/b] for your feedback.
We started working on [i]The Price of Freedom[/i] six months ago. We were really proud of what we'd created, but pretty sure none of us expected the kind of positive reaction we've gotten.
It's amazing to see the emotional response our little experience has been getting from people!

And especially thank you to people that wrote thought out critiques. Cuz that's how we make our next work better.

And there WILL be more to come 😉

-Construct Studio

非常感謝各位的支持和回覆！
我們在六個月前開始製作《自由代價》，真的非常高興可以讓大家來體驗我們的作品。沒想到有這麼熱烈的迴響連我們自己都嚇了一大跳。看了各位對於我們短短作品的心得文讓我們覺得《自由代價》能夠帶給各位這麼多感受感覺真的很好！

特別感謝給予我們意見和批評的玩家們，因為我們可以從中學習並讓我們的下一集變得更好。

是的，我們會有後續的製作，敬請期待 😉

-看思築工作室
